name: Building Data Genome Project 2 (BDG2)
license: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record 3887306)
variables: Hourly meter readings (electricity, chilled water, hot water, steam, irrigation) for 3,053 meters in 1,636 non-residential buildings; building metadata; weather
suitability: Primary dataset for load forecasting, feature engineering and meter anomaly work; chilled-water meters are a loose proxy for cooling load in capstone 1.
caveats: Not data-center data; many meters have long zero runs and gaps. Includes the GEPIII subset (2,380 meters, 1,449 buildings), whose original Kaggle data may carry Kaggle competition terms, so prefer the CC BY 4.0 BDG2 copy.

name: ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III (Kaggle)
license: Kaggle competition rules (not read; page requires JS and login-gated acceptance)
variables: Meter readings, building metadata, hourly weather
suitability: Classic benchmark for gradient boosting and leakage-aware validation.
caveats: Competition terms typically limit use to the competition and may forbid redistribution; use the BDG2 release instead for the course. Rules page not verified.

name: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets
license: OEDI public access (DOI 10.25984/1881324); check page for explicit licence before redistribution
variables: Labeled operational time series with faults at several severities plus fault-free cases for RTU, single- and dual-duct AHU, VAV box, fan coil unit, chiller plant and boiler plant; Brick TTL metadata and PDF documentation
sampling: varies by system (minute to hourly), not verified
suitability: Best open labeled HVAC FDD data; use for supervised and semi-supervised fault detection and as ground truth for the capstone 2 diagnosis agent.
caveats: Mix of simulation, lab and field data; sampling and labelling conventions differ per dataset; read each PDF before use.

name: ASHRAE RP-1043 chiller fault data (Comstock and Braun)
license: ASHRAE research project; distribution terms not verified
variables: Controlled-fault tests on a 90-ton centrifugal chiller with seven fault types at four severities (from memory)
suitability: Classic chiller FDD benchmark; physically meaningful features (approach temperatures, COP).
caveats: I did not locate a free official download; it may be sold through ASHRAE or obtained from academic mirrors of uncertain licence. Treat as unavailable until the library confirms.

name: NREL ComStock and ResStock (End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. Building Stock)
license: Open data via OEDI (CC BY 4.0 per OEDI as I recall; not verified)
size: very large (parquet on S3); subsets are practical
variables: Simulated end-use load profiles by building type and county, with weather-year and building characteristics
suitability: Synthetic building load profiles with known physics; used by CityLearn v2 for RL; good source for controlled experiments with known counterfactuals.
caveats: Simulated rather than measured; URL and licence from memory, not page-verified.

name: NREL National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB)
license: Open (NREL data policy); API key required; not verified
variables: Solar irradiance and meteorological variables on a 2 km grid
suitability: Weather features for cooling load and solar forecasting.
caveats: Not page-verified. For dry-bulb and wet-bulb temperature in the cooling capstone, TMY or NOAA station data may be simpler.

name: Google Borg cluster traces (2011 and 2019)
license: CC-BY 4.0 for 2019 traces (stated in repo docs); 2011 terms in ClusterData2011_2.md
size: 2019 trace is multi-TB in BigQuery/GCS (not recorded exactly)
variables: Job and task events, resource requests and usage, machine attributes; 2019 covers 8 cells for May 2019
suitability: Workload forecasting and scheduling, load shape for IT power.
caveats: Not facility cooling data; anonymized and normalized resource units; 2019 access is via BigQuery.

name: Google PowerData2019 (data center power-domain traces)
license: CC-BY 4.0 (stated in the file)
variables: Power utilization for 57 power domains in Google data centers, linked to the 8 cells of the 2019 cluster trace; 2 domains in the medium-voltage power plane design
sampling: not recorded in what I read (see power_trace_documentation.pdf)
suitability: The only public, large-operator data-center power telemetry I found; use for power forecasting, peak/capping analysis and anomaly detection, and to calibrate a simulator's IT load.
caveats: Power only, no cooling or temperature data; the README asks users to join the mailing list with a stated reason. Documentation PDF not read.

name: Alibaba cluster traces
license: No licence file in the repo; read per-trace terms
size: v2017: about 1,300 machines over 12 hours; others larger
variables: Machine and container usage, batch jobs, co-located online services; later traces add GPU data
suitability: Cluster utilization forecasting and co-location studies.
caveats: Licence unclear; no facility data.

name: Azure Public Dataset (VM traces and LLM inference traces)
license: CC BY 4.0 (GitHub API licence field)
variables: VM creation, lifetime, utilization; LLM inference invocations with input/output token counts (Nov 2023, May 2024); multimodal inference (Oct 2024); Copilot coding-agent trace
sampling: VM utilization 5-minute (from memory); LLM traces per request
suitability: Realistic arrival patterns for LLM serving load, which can drive the data-center simulator's IT load in capstone 1 and capacity planning in module 27.
caveats: Anonymized and sampled; no power or thermal data.

name: Backblaze Drive Stats
license: Backblaze terms: cite Backblaze, use at your own responsibility, derivative works may be sold, the data itself may not be sold
size: quarterly zips of about 1 to 2 GB (Q2 2026: 2.1 GB zipped, 11.7 GB unzipped, 91 daily files); lifetime 558M drive days
variables: Daily snapshot per drive: model, serial, capacity, failure flag, raw and normalized SMART attributes (schema changes over time)
suitability: Failure prediction with severe class imbalance, time-based splits, survival analysis and calibration.
caveats: Rare positives (annual failure rate about 1.4 percent); schema changes across quarters; a Q2 2026 snapshot shows AFR 1.73 percent. Leakage risk if rows from the same drive straddle train/test.

name: NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation
license: NASA open data; terms not verified
variables: Run-to-failure multivariate sensor series for simulated engines, four sub-datasets
suitability: Remaining-useful-life prediction for rotating equipment such as pumps and fans.
caveats: Simulated; ageing run-to-failure benchmarks are prone to the label issues Wu and Keogh describe; URL from memory.

name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB)
license: MIT (GitHub API)
variables: Labeled univariate streams including AWS CloudWatch server metrics
suitability: Teaching streaming detectors and the NAB score.
caveats: Flawed per Wu and Keogh (triviality, label noise); use for demonstration, not for claims.

name: SKAB (Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark)
license: GPL-3.0 (GitHub API)
variables: Multivariate sensor data (vibration, current, pressure, temperature, flow) from a water circulation testbed with labeled anomalies and changepoints
suitability: Small physical-plant multivariate anomaly benchmark closest in spirit to cooling-loop sensors.
caveats: GPL-3.0 licence may constrain bundling; labelling quality not audited.

name: UCR Time Series Anomaly Archive
license: Distributed via the UCR archive page (terms not verified)
variables: Single labeled anomaly per series, constructed to avoid the four flaws
suitability: Cleaner benchmark for detector comparison; pair with the Wu and Keogh critique.
caveats: Univariate; synthetic-ish anomalies in places; download link not verified.

name: Open Power System Data (OPSD)
license: Mostly CC BY 4.0 per data package (from memory; not verified)
variables: European hourly load, wind and solar generation, prices, weather
suitability: Clean grid-scale load forecasting with weather covariates.
caveats: Not page-verified; coverage mostly Europe; package versions freeze at various dates.

name: EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (via EIA Open Data API)
license: Free; API key registration and ToS; EIA reuse policy
variables: Demand, forecast demand, net generation by fuel type, interchange per balancing authority
suitability: Grid demand and fuel mix, for carbon-intensity proxies and carbon-aware scheduling studies in the US.
caveats: Data are revised and have outliers and missing hours; fuel-mix based carbon intensity is an average, not marginal, signal.

name: CAISO OASIS
license: Public market data; terms not verified
variables: Locational marginal prices, load forecasts, renewables, ancillary services
suitability: Real electricity price series for demand-response and MPC cost objectives.
caveats: Not page-verified; API returns zipped CSV/XML with rate limits.

name: ERCOT public data
license: Public data; terms not verified
variables: System load, prices, wind and solar generation
suitability: Texas grid data (a major data-center region), including price spikes useful for risk-aware control.
caveats: Not page-verified; portal changes frequently.

name: Electricity Maps API
license: Commercial service with a free tier; terms not verified (the page did not load before my read)
variables: Grid carbon intensity (lifecycle), power breakdown by zone
suitability: Average carbon intensity signal for carbon-aware scheduling demos.
caveats: Free tier limits, history depth and permitted use must be read before use; redistribution of data is likely restricted.

name: WattTime API
license: API terms; registration required; free-access scope not verified
variables: Marginal operating emissions rate (co2_moer, lbs/MWh), forecasts, historical
suitability: Marginal emissions signal, which is the right one for load shifting.
caveats: Check coverage and free tier; cannot ship the data in the course repo.

name: Public data-center facility telemetry (cooling, PUE, CRAH/CRAC, chiller)
license: n/a
variables: None found
suitability: I found no public dataset of full facility cooling telemetry from an operating data center; the closest are Google's 2019 power traces (power only), Backblaze (drive SMART incl. temperature) and building-HVAC datasets (BDG2, LBNL FDD).
caveats: This gap justifies building the course's own simulator and synthetic telemetry generator; validate it against BOPTEST and LBNL data and state the sim-to-real limit.

name: Public maintenance work-order or fault-report corpora
license: unknown
variables: Free-text maintenance work orders (e.g. the MaintNet / MaintIE efforts from UWA) are the nearest public resources, from memory
suitability: No public data-center or HVAC maintenance log corpus was verified. Plan on synthetic logs generated from the simulator's injected faults (and LBNL fault labels), optionally mixed with a small public work-order corpus for style realism.
caveats: MaintNet and similar corpora are not page-verified; mark as a lead to check. Synthetic logs risk LLM-style artifacts that inflate eval scores, so write them with templates, noise, abbreviations and incorrect entries.
